content: When the delay timer of a NodeChannel expires in sub state ‘ Claiming’, the J1939 Network Management module shall switch that NodeChannel to state ‘NormalOperation’ and shall report this state change to the Basic Software Mode Manager via BswM_J1939Nm_State ChangeNotification(NM_STATE_NORMAL_OPERATION) .

When the delay timer of a NodeChannel expires in sub state ‘ Claiming’, the J1939 Network Management module shall switch that NodeChannel to state ‘NormalOperation’ and shall report this state change to the Basic Software Mode Manager via BswM_J1939Nm_StateChangeNotification(NM_STATE_NORMAL_OPERATION) .

When the delay timer of a NodeChannel expires in sub state ‘ Claiming’, the J1939 Network Management module shall switch that NodeChannel to state ‘NormalOperation’ and shall report this state change to the Basic Software Mode Manager via BswM_J1939Nm_State ChangeNotification(NM_STATE_NORMAL_OPERATION) .
